# git: alias: refactor alias.whoami and alias.delta

Part of [[DOT-354]]:

- rename `bin/lib/git/whoami.bash` to `git/info.bash`;
- replace the inline `whoami` alias by `!@ git-whoami`;
- add a `git-delta` function (`GIT_PAGER='delta -s' git diff`) and replace the inline `delta` alias by `!@ git-delta`.
